diagnosis.root_cause: Co-channel or adjacent-channel interference from a nearby transmitter, or seasonal fading affecting the microwave path.
diagnosis.recommended_action: Do not auto-remediate. Frequency changes affect a live service-affecting path — escalate to the RF planning team with the interference log attached.

ticket.root_cause: Co-channel or adjacent-channel interference from a nearby transmitter, or seasonal fading affecting the microwave path.
ticket.recommended_action: Do not auto-remediate. Frequency changes affect a live service-affecting path — escalate to the RF planning team with the interference log attached.

diagnosis.root_cause: Physical layer failure — either a fiber cut, a failed SFP transceiver, or the remote-end radio unit lost sync.
diagnosis.recommended_action: Check optical Rx/Tx levels on the SFP first. If levels are within spec, escalate to a field technician for a physical link inspection.

ticket.root_cause: Physical layer failure — either a fiber cut, a failed SFP transceiver, or the remote-end radio unit lost sync.
ticket.recommended_action: Check optical Rx/Tx levels on the SFP first. If levels are within spec, escalate to a field technician for a physical link inspection.

diagnosis.root_cause: Optical attenuation is creeping up, usually from a dirty connector, a bend in the fiber, or transceiver aging.
diagnosis.recommended_action: Trigger a remote SFP diagnostics poll and log the trend. If Rx power has degraded more than 3dB over 7 days, auto-open a maintenance ticket.

outcome.action_taken: Trigger a remote SFP diagnostics poll and log the trend. If Rx power has degraded more than 3dB over 7 days, auto-open a maintenance ticket.

diagnosis.root_cause: Short-lived thermal spike, most often caused by a blocked vent, a fan running below expected RPM, or a brief HVAC issue in the cabinet room.
diagnosis.recommended_action: Auto-restart the cooling fan controller and re-poll temperature in 5 minutes. Only escalate if the spike persists past two polling cycles.

outcome.action_taken: Auto-restart the cooling fan controller and re-poll temperature in 5 minutes. Only escalate if the spike persists past two polling cycles.

diagnosis.root_cause: Minor mechanical variance in fan RPM, typically within normal tolerance and self-correcting.
diagnosis.recommended_action: Log and suppress. No action needed unless variance recurs more than 5 times in 24 hours.

outcome.action_taken: Log and suppress. No action needed unless variance recurs more than 5 times in 24 hours.
